headline: H100 SXM is the only mover, up +7% over 7 days; MI300X leads price-performance.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index is $4.62, up +7% over 7 days, while B200, H200, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were flat at +0%.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, ahead of B200 at $3.78, though only 4 providers list it.
Hyperscaler premiums are widest on H100 SXM at +151%, where the hyperscaler median of $10.68 compares with a neocloud median of $4.25.
B200 carries a market index of $8.50, with the hyperscaler median at $14.12 and the cheapest provider, RunPod Community Cloud, at $5.98.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, despite Vast.ai listing it at $1.14.
watch: Whether the +7% move in H100 SXM extends, particularly against its $2.68 marketplace median and Vast.ai's $2.67 low.
